_comment: Exact input Research Brief for the real Claude Code quality run. It is a fixture: the run consumes it verbatim, and the brief is never edited to fit a result.

input.research_question: Which publicly funded cultural and leisure organisations operate a permanent public venue in the bounded geography, and what is the official published route by which a member of the public contacts each one?

geography.name: Greater London, United Kingdom
geography.bounding: the 32 London boroughs plus the City of London
excluded: organisations whose only presence in the geography is a ticketing reseller or a venue hire broker
anything requiring a login, a paid database or a private account to view

output.deliverable: one spreadsheet of candidate rows plus the evidence artefacts they cite
output.review_status: candidate_unverified until a human reviewer accepts a row

budget.note: no outreach, no form submission, no email, no private-site access, no charged API call

hard_prohibitions: invented person names, email addresses, phone numbers or roles
presenting a search-result snippet as if it were the source page
storing a CAPTCHA, login or challenge page as validated evidence
accessing any private, paid or login-walled resource
outreach of any kind: contacting any organisation, submitting any web form, sending any message or email
publishing personal data of any individual

acceptance_thresholds._comment: Deliberately absent. §3 of the owner document says the first real baseline sets realistic thresholds; inventing 100%-everything targets now would be a fake pass criterion.
